document.title: Colorado Academic Standards: Reading, Writing and Communicating

00AF741A8BEF4D0D8F2F288953AED3C3.description: Speak in complete sentences when appropriate to task and situation in order to provide requested detail or clarification.

01B831C7B25F41D482A9616635F6C0AC.description: Come to discussions prepared, having read or studied required material; explicitly draw on that preparation and other information known about the topic to explore ideas under discussion.

02F6E07EA1E44B728C867FDD31E98D9D.description: Recognize and observe differences between the conventions of spoken and written standard English. )

0341AB2959524414BFA3C460C4ED07CF.description: Follow agreed-upon rules for discussions (for example: gaining the floor in respectful ways, listening to others with care, speaking one at a time about the topics and texts under discussion).

05C3E636E8C145549B15A45F966F9214.description: Read grade level text accurately and fluently, attending to phrasing, intonation, and punctuation.

05E0EABB30BD40EFA2B0C1B4593FD1C4.description: Use spelling patterns and generalizations (for example: word families, position-based spellings, syllable patterns, ending rules, meaningful word parts) in writing words.

06BA2F85BD794DF19C4990005D331CBC.description: Apply strategies to fluently read and comprehend various informational texts.

083E8094FD9E44738CD4116B7AF38784.description: Compare and contrast the most important points and key details presented in two texts on the same topic.

09A24D25C31E494C89BA3E2A016EE737.description: Ask and answer questions to demonstrate understanding of a text, referring explicitly to the text as the basis for the answers.

0B9020F4F4FF4F5284BDED2EB6664072.description: Decode words with common Latin suffixes.

0BA12DB8DB3A4F5396161D692D76D066.description: Demonstrate understanding of figurative language, word relationships and nuances in word meanings.

0CB0BDF4B918436AA760AD26E825D6E3.description: Choose words and phrases for effect.

0D59A1AAB2084CBDA3A736BAD6355DB9.description: Read grade-level prose and poetry orally with accuracy, appropriate rate, and expression.

114B50018A3340338A893A3ABAECE63D.description: Describe the relationship between a series of historical events, scientific ideas or concepts, or steps in technical procedures in a text, using language that pertains to time, sequence, and cause/effect.

16B6618DFA334D47B29C1D31CC5555F1.description: Gather, interpret, and communicate information discovered during short research projects.

16CCE2AF1C844C63BF27E769AA5BC93B.description: Use a known root word as a clue to the meaning of an unknown word with the same root (for example: company, companion).

1A1E5454A8024E30BBFFDC7919F29738.description: Introduce the topic or text they are writing about, state an opinion, and create an organizational structure that includes reasons.

1AD6A472BBF04D6D875E4C5FFA0658F5.description: By the end of the year, read and comprehend literature, including stories, dramas, and poetry, at the high end of the grades 2-3 text complexity band independently and proficiently.

2304597CDD2E4AD6BD71135D8A1A01CC.description: Form and use regular and irregular verbs.

24000C47420D4491B98EAE829B87BD60.description: Identify real-life connections between words and their use (for example: describe people who are friendly or helpful).

242688E97868458E94CEE9F32E72470F.description: Summarize central ideas and important details from a text.

26DF21BC64B84460938894C2DD4DDF72.description: Provide a concluding statement or section.

2877D2CFA50E4C15BD7332E639FC3302.description: Describe and draw inferences about the elements of plot, character, and setting in literary pieces, poems, and plays.

29301C425B9D4F788DEE6CD5D5A6370F.description: Use a variety of comprehension strategies to interpret text (attending, searching, predicting, checking, and self-correcting).

2A68BBA053F74BD6B206C984ECA9A29C.description: Establish a situation and introduce a narrator and/or characters; organize an event sequence that unfolds naturally.

2D2E1C43ADC2470298F9D43328C2803F.description: Conduct short research projects that build knowledge about a topic.

306D3EE48483470CABCAD0C440DD3FDD.description: Write routinely over extended time frames (time for research, reflection, and revision) and shorter time frames (a single sitting or a day or two) for a range of discipline-specific tasks, purposes, and audiences.

33708FB1AEF541C3B57EB8CA401FD73E.description: Determine the main ideas and supporting details of a text read aloud or information presented in diverse media and formats, including visually, quantitatively, and orally.

34E49CF6777D4BA5B64CF71F622A2B1B.description: Produce simple, compound, and complex sentences using coordinating and subordinating conjunctions.

3735036680A44DEBA0AF7F4C41EAC435.description: Communicate using appropriate language in informal and formal situations.

3894CC9233494B2B886A85C43DE588B8.description: Vary sentence beginnings, and use long and short sentences to create sentence fluency in longer texts

399645CCA8FC4C01988776740D26BEEB.description: Acquire and use accurately grade-appropriate conversational, general academic, and domain-specific words and phrases, including those that signal spatial and temporal relationships (for example: After dinner that night we went looking for them).

39C5E632CC1842089C5905CABDA23C5D.description: Write informative/explanatory texts developed with facts, definitions, and details, ending with a related concluding statement.

3E75F6386F524A70BBA91F62C5BD1F59.description: Introduce a topic and group related information together; include illustrations when useful to aiding comprehension.

4422452010E7473CA9419A549D569B90.description: Develop supporting visual information (for example: charts, maps, illustrations, models).

458D7E6353AA48309D0F1F54ABD97602.description: Ask and answer questions about information from a speaker, offering appropriate elaboration and detail.

45D47DAB769041C08E76A44638EA2A4D.description: Demonstrate command of the conventions of Standard English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing.

4656F6166F25424D94AD5B4E0A261B5F.description: Determine the meaning of general academic and domain-specific words and phrases in a text relevant to a grade 3 topic or subject area.

47A63C4B5A3F4F87AF3301C5A0B13EBD.description: Form and use the simple (for example: I walked; I walk; I will walk) verb tenses.

4A0D6B47A9924F26B3CB77EB493AE127.description: Refer to parts of stories, dramas, and poems when writing or speaking about a text, using terms such as chapter, scene, and stanza; describe how each successive part builds on earlier sections.

5128FA30C9DC40E194789D7D3B35FAD4.description: Recount stories, including fables, folktales, and myths from diverse cultures; determine the central message, lesson, or moral and explain how it is conveyed through key details in the text.

520E50B087394D529C0E1C82EFE27A37.description: Demonstrate command of the conventions of Standard English grammar and usage when writing or speaking.

57ABACAA62A04F3E8FEA3C3C84C65A77.description: Consult reference materials, including beginning dictionaries, as needed to check and correct spellings.

58D6B9F326294DEAA911D96014D23E7F.description: Form and use comparative and superlative adjectives and adverbs, and choose between them depending on what is to be modified.

5CE2417FDCC147E7B53121BD3AEF23CE.description: Use Range of Reading and Complexity of Text to:

5DC5F20E7859443B8E18C6A3AB82FF69.description: Distinguish the literal and nonliteral meanings of words and phrases in context (for example: take steps).

5DEA942F2EB84899B507C0271A2C2A67.description: Use commas and quotation marks in dialogue.

5F02429FA7C24B9E8BE395A92083796E.description: With guidance and support from adults, produce writing in which the development and organization are appropriate to task and purpose.

5F7BE83501814460B97E921A53C5762E.description: Know and apply grade-level phonics and word analysis skills in decoding words.

619E49F12B63445CBFD32510B166AD3D.description: Create engaging audio recordings of stories or poems that demonstrate fluid reading at an understandable pace; add visual displays when appropriate to emphasize or enhance certain facts or details.

623DCCE750BC4BE29CB94D338626814B.description: Speak clearly, using appropriate volume and pitch for the purpose and audience.

64CA11F90EDD4801A514BBBD8FB6F5DA.description: With guidance and support from peers and adults, develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, and editing.

6C357DEF24AE48628AC3C05E0463D950.description: Use text features and search tools (for example: key words, sidebars, hyperlinks) to locate information relevant to a given topic efficiently.

6F8B28377FBA449C84594F8F33ADB618.description: Determine the main idea of a text; recount the key details and explain how they support the main idea.

724CC080670F440C88FF0CB0F1D7ADF1.description: Use Integration of Knowledge and Ideas to:

72A6BAF3711B49C08090CADBB6C4E8AD.description: Use knowledge of language and its conventions when writing, speaking, reading, or listening.

740BA02652D246F3B82AE50346167F22.description: Provide a concluding statement or section.

770036B69E9A4BC7A43F3C520F306CCD.description: Distinguish their own point of view from that of the author of a text.

77476BEB768A420190593A5AB8C6DEEA.description: Determine the meaning of the new word formed when a known affix is added to a known word (for example: agreeable/disagreeable, comfortable/uncomfortable, care/careless, heat/preheat).

7983C705194949AEA54D3DBC928D314D.description: Use information gained from illustrations (for example: maps, photographs) and the words in a text to demonstrate understanding of the text (for example: where, when, why, and how key events occur).

7A4D44E3647D4B3B8E3C764085D9A3DE.description: Read grade-level text with purpose and understanding.

83320CEBF99B48398C76A2291574111C.description: Ask questions to check understanding of information presented, stay on topic, and link their comments to the remarks of others.

840DD15ED43D48BABD035104A5AC2E1E.description: Ask and answer questions to demonstrate understanding of a text, referring explicitly to the text as the basis for the answers.

890EB36CCB0F4EF4BA37657ADE8B64FC.description: Use Key Ideas and Details to:

8C91904164734F029E7B8766607A9175.description: Use signal words (such as before, after, next) and text structure (narrative, chronology) to determine the sequence of major events

8E0878AC26E64C4A977CAE5BF1613E42.description: Use linking words and phrases (for example: also, another, and, more, but) to connect ideas within categories of information.

8F79F891F47840B39954EAA46AFD9CB6.description: Determine the meaning of words and phrases as they are used in a text, distinguishing literal from nonliteral language.

90083534E3D64643944107CA36DCE320.description: Present a brief report of the research findings to an audience.

92CC1CFC92DC42B0ACC934AD8687DB5D.description: Use Integration of Knowledge and Ideas to:

9B8B69BDF62642EA905A94515B7A629E.description: Apply strategies to fluently read and comprehend various literary texts.

9BCC57E6ECFD43F29EB0E25C6003222A.description: With guidance and support from adults, use technology to produce and publish writing (using keyboarding skills) as well as to interact and collaborate with others.

A5857C1807104A84A6CE8A9518943968.description: Use dialogue and descriptions of actions, thoughts, and feelings to develop experiences and events or show the response of characters to situations.

A6E772BEFDF541D991DB3927D3AE1686.description: Describe characters in a story (for example: their traits, motivations, or feelings) and explain how their actions contribute to the sequence of events.

A828541B6A5F4DC5B9B6E840DF7A9C8F.description: Explain the function of nouns, pronouns, verbs, adjectives, and adverbs in general and their functions in particular sentences.

A91ABD82B1C4460DA4EDCC87AD3E9C15.description: Use conventional spelling for high-frequency and other studied words and for adding suffixes to base words (for example: sitting, smiled, cries, happiness).

AB8F604C0F07439CB96276EC663DE840.description: Write opinion pieces on topics or texts, supporting a point of view with reasons.

B2AC95D7C19149CD8CB2CC0E41E8933E.description: Identify and know the meaning of the most common prefixes and derivational suffixes.

B825B02BC22F44D09B2A6318A03A23A7.description: Explain their own ideas and understanding in light of the discussion.

BBD57C4FADB74D74928E42CFEFA5ADA7.description: By the end of the year, read and comprehend informational texts, including history/social studies, science, and technical texts, at the high end of the grades 2–3 text complexity band independently and proficiently.

BE48876DDAF647CC95CFF50C029E0FBD.description: Provide reasons that support the opinion.

C1311E3144F64938B00E171EE99023C2.description: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on grade 3 topics and texts, building on others' ideas and expressing their own clearly.

C2AC9EBAE4C54DFD81A5A479E0842B44.description: Use temporal words and phrases to signal event order.

C62302EF72BB4FB2AB45529F89D6C901.description: Use sentence-level context as a clue to the meaning of a word or phrase.

C7DE62E434304A718DAD6307415C75FA.description: Use semantic cues and signal words (for example: because and although) to identify cause/effect and compare/contrast relationships.

C7F99A1C509240468F0C0F3059279489.description: Develop the topic with facts, definitions, and details.

CC34FA0E61614AFE8354A6E2DE890DB4.description: Write real or imagined narratives that use descriptive details, have a clear sequence of events, and provide closure.

CE9DFD7D2A464EF2887C11644AF1396B.description: Use Range of Reading and Complexity of Text to:

D1645F6AEE1343F7BB03C2CC0A2C6581.description: Use glossaries or beginning dictionaries, both print and digital, to determine or clarify the precise meaning of key words and phrases.

D1CC96F98C384E4A9C99EE4FBFBD6026.description: Use context to confirm or self-correct word recognition and understanding, rereading as necessary.

D2C3FC11536B4BC78909AC67EEB69536.description: Select and organize ideas sequentially or around major points of information that relate to the formality of the audience.

D32F132A3B684D098C0DCE735FAADE0C.description: Distinguish shades of meaning among related words that describe states of mind or degrees of certainty (for example: knew, believed, suspected, heard, wondered).

D832748C14014D53932B09E5B6C769D3.description: Identify a main topic of a multi-paragraph text as well as the focus of specific paragraphs within the text

D9AF37E828834616A891A590A57CF112.description: Describe the logical connection between particular sentences and paragraphs in a text (for example: comparison, cause/effect, first/second/third in a sequence).

E00B43E9AA86400289BDCFD51F60ED2B.description: Use linking words and phrases (for example: because, therefore, since, for example) to connect opinion and reasons.

E07A90679FE64D72A308AD6B50299A0C.description: Apply knowledge of spelling patterns (orthography), word meanings (morphology), and word relationships to decode words and increase vocabulary.

E0E6A7B7982645E493ED1DC26C110F08.description: Use a recursive process to plan, draft, revise, and edit writing, applying knowledge of the conventions of grammar, capitalization, punctuation, and spelling.

E138E7BDB6884745AB75C0E4B7B1F212.description: Determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning word and phrases based on grade 3 reading and content, choosing flexibly from a range of strategies.

E46E047FC9D5481F8FB84D1717B27BB2.description: Report on a topic or text, tell a story, or recount an experience with appropriate facts and relevant, descriptive details, speaking clearly at an understandable pace.

E6E15CA8476A46A0B356CF2CE9DC1C78.description: Recall information from experiences or gather information from print and digital sources; take brief notes on sources and sort evidence into provided categories.

EB19562B906742BDB01843BF59C28CD9.description: Distinguish their own point of view from that of the narrator or those of the characters.

EC2F53803AB147D5BB459696B53B419A.description: Read with sufficient accuracy and fluency to support comprehension.

F2ED090FDB124AECB8F0BA5E19D26D9F.description: Use knowledge of word relationships to identify antonyms or synonyms to clarify meaning.

F3B66CF1740046EABEADAD132E530AAC.description: Explain how specific aspects of a text's illustrations contribute to what is conveyed by the words in a story (for example: create mood, emphasize aspects of a character or setting).

F558AC2C58C34ECE98C5880087BC2B45.description: Determine the meaning of general academic and domain-specific words and phrases in a text relevant to a grade 3 topic or subject area.

FC2571C1172B4D35B05802F4679820EA.description: Use Key Ideas and Details to:

FCE8AEC581F041B687247A1F8FA83CE6.description: Interpret and communicate the information learned by developing a brief summary with supporting details.

FFC019342E344F40B062FF7BB50E721C.description: Compare and contrast the themes, settings, and plots of stories written by the same author about the same or similar characters (for example: in books from a series).
